intended_object: An auxiliary unitary that Alice applies in the library's internal quantum parallel-repetition argument (the "DSV density rational heterogeneous target-first spectral" construction). It is inferred from the name and from the docstring, which only restates the name.
explanation: The definition only plugs other internal constructions of the same library into one another: a local lift, a physical-history unitary and a heterogeneous Alice unitary. Its dimensions are tied to an internal phase-residual count. The docstring calls it a construction "used in the quantum parallel-repetition argument", so it is a step inside a proof. It does not correspond to any standard object in the literature. Searching the library, it is used only in Part06 (3 occurrences, including the definition) and Part09 (8), as an internal step there. No Mathlib counterpart exists.
